current.text: He is projected to start for Dallas. Josh's projected starting five is Kyrie Irving, Christie, Cooper Flagg, P.J. Washington and Morez Johnson Jr.
New head coach Dusty May has said Christie will have a breakout year.
Experts see no real upside, especially with Kyrie Irving back. Josh is not interested in him outside 18 or 20 team leagues, so he is not a draft target in a 12-team league.
Cooper Flagg is the first option on offense and Kyrie Irving is the second, which caps Christie's shots.
Dallas has a 4-4-4 schedule in the fantasy playoffs, probably the best in the league, but also a league-high 16 back-to-backs.
Dallas has a two-game week in the matchup that starts March 1.
Dallas has no pick of its own, so it has no reason to tank late in the season.

durable.text: He is an efficient shooter: about 40% from three and about 90% at the line. He takes under two free throws a game, so his FT% moves a team ratio only a little.
He gives little outside threes and free throws. He rarely passes, does not create steals or blocks and does not crash the glass. Steals are his weakest category.
Josh says he struggles to scale up his scoring and is not a big self-creator.

note: He is priced at 0 USD on both Yahoo and ESPN (Yahoo rank 256, ESPN 183), and he went undrafted in our league. Experts only want him in 18 or 20 team leagues, so let him go undrafted in our 144-player auction. Early in the season, check on waivers whether Dusty May's offense raises his shot volume above about 9 to 10 attempts a game, or whether a Kyrie Irving absence opens usage. If it does, his threes, FT% and Dallas's 4-4-4 playoff schedule could make him a useful streamer for builds that need threes.
